Question Choices: Fill: Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 2 and height 9. (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ only, e.g. 10 for $10\pi$)
Solution: Use πr²h. The coefficient of π is (2)²×9=36. The volume is (36)π cubic units. Enter only the coefficient: 36.

Question Choices: Fill: A sphere has a radius of 2. Find its volume. (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ only, as a fraction if needed)
Solution: Use (4/3)πr³. The coefficient of π is (4/3)×(2)³=32/3. The volume is (32/3)π cubic units. Enter only the coefficient: 32/3.
